column1: # Code in boundary_conditions, reactions and trajectory_functions that neither
# cases.tsv nor coverage_cases.tsv executes, with what was tried.
# running every case in both tables, merging with `llvm-profdata merge -sparse`
# and reading `llvm-cov report -show-functions`.  A function listed here showed
# 0.00% region coverage across the whole merged profile.
# This file exists because the absence of a case is invisible.  A bitwise suite
# that does not reach a function reports "identical" for any change to it,
# including a wrong one, and reports it in exactly the same words as for code it
# does reach.  Anything edited here has to be argued for some other way - by
# construction, by reading, or by a case added on purpose - and the argument
# function <TAB> why it is not reached <TAB> what was tried

column2: Everything under `if (canExclude == true)` from line 202 to the end of the function. Needs a MolTemplate with excludeVolumeBound set, which no sample input has. It re-implements the 1D/2D/3D geometry inline and holds five copies of the crossing-record block, so it looks like the largest remaining duplication target in reactions and is the least safe one.
column3: All cases in both tables: line 202 has 0 hits while line 200 has 2.82G.

column2: Gated on Molecule::enforceCompartmentBC, which only check_compartment_reaction sets, and only for a molecule that has crossed into the compartment. In sample_inputs/compartment molecules only ever exit.
column3: compartment at nItr 4000 and 8000: check_compartment_reaction reaches 52% and determine_exiting_compartment_probability 100%, but determine_entering_compartment_probability stays at 0.00% and so does this.

column2: Reached only when a molecule is about to enter the compartment; the one compartment sample has them leaving.
Reached only when the cluster sweep gives up and falls back to pairs, so it needs a crowded spherical membrane run for long enough to hit that. gagsphere does reach it, but not cheaply.
column3: VALIDATE_SUITE/sphere at nItr 40000 and 150000: 0.00%. gagsphere/parms.inp with clusterOverlapCheck: 0.00% at nItr 1000, 82.67% at nItr 20000 - which takes eleven minutes, too slow for a suite that runs on every change. Raise cluster_gagsphere's nItr if this one matters.

column2: Needs Complex::onFiber, which no sample input sets.

Only called when reflect_traj_complex_rad_rot_{box,sphere} finds a complex that reaches past both opposite walls, or that its own correction would push out the far side. Every model here has a box far larger than its complexes.
column3: All 13 cases.tsv cases plus all coverage_cases.tsv cases: 0.00%.

column2: Only caller is reflect_traj_check_span, and reflect_traj_complex_rad_rot_box directly under the same condition.
Reached only when a complex reaches outside the sphere after propagation.
Only called from the two check_span routines, after they resample a failed move.
column3: As above; unreachable for as long as check_span is.

column2: Its only caller is the `com1.onFiber && com2.onFiber` arm of check_bimolecular_reactions() (line 193), so it needs Complex::onFiber, which no sample input sets -- the same gate that already keeps sweep_separation_complex_rot_fiber dark. Added while editing this function for the reweighting merge on the molecule-layout branch: a bitwise pass over both tables says nothing about it, so changes here have to be argued by reading.
column3: No .inp under sample_inputs mentions onFiber; both case tables leave the fiber arm at 0 hits.

column2: Both call sites, break_interaction.cpp:209 and :216, are commented out, so the function is unreachable.  It is also inert if reached: it displaces a local copy of the molecule and discards it, and its moleculeList parameter is const so it could not write back.  Its only distinguishing input is bndRxnList[0], which is empty on every sphere and implicit-lipid model.  See docs/bond_bookkeeping_defects.md.
column3: No caller in any build; the two commented calls are gated on Complex::onFiber, which no sample input sets.
